objet: Next step on your French tax position
disponibilite: We remain at your disposal for any question.

corps.p: I thank you for your time on the call this morning.

On the facts you have given us so far, your exposure may well prove narrower than you expect. Our review will settle it year by year, and it will give you a firm position to build your talent passport project on.
Five items are enough to start. They are the ones that matter most in the list sent to you earlier today.

corps.b: a copy of your passport, with your French visas and residence permits
your estimate of the days spent in France each year since your arrival, together with your lease
your United States income tax returns for the last three years, with their schedules
your share of the Californian property, the way it is held, and the loan documents if it is financed
a list of your bank and investment accounts held outside France, with the highest balance reached on each

corps.p: We will revert quickly with our position and a fixed fee for the work. Anything further can follow later, and we will come back to you if we need it.
